# LZX Technical Manual - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview

This is the **LZX Technical Manual**, a Docusaurus-based documentation site for LZX Industries video synthesizer products. The site documents modular video synthesis hardware including modules, instruments, cases, and power supplies across multiple product generations (Visionary, Expedition, Orion, Gen3, P-Series, Automata, Castle).

- **Live site**: https://docs.lzxindustries.net
- **Repository**: lzxindustries/lzxtm
- **Framework**: Docusaurus 3.x (TypeScript)
- **Deployment**: GitHub Pages via PowerShell script (no CI/CD yet)

## Architecture & Structure

### Content Organization

- `/docs/` - Main documentation organized into auto-generated sidebars:
  - `guides/` - General user guides (what is video synthesis, first patch, standards, troubleshooting)
  - `modules/` - Individual module documentation (DSG3, DWO3, ESG3, FKG3, etc.)
  - `instruments/` - Complete instrument docs (Chromagnon, Vidiot, Videomancer, Double Vision)
  - `case-and-power/` - Power and case system documentation
- `/blog/` - Development updates and announcements with date-based folders (`YYYY-MM-DD-slug/index.md`)
- `/static/` - Static assets:
  - `firmware/` - Firmware binaries organized as `{module}_{version}/` folders containing `.bin` files
  - `pdf/` - PDF documentation organized by product/module subdirectories
  - `zip/apps/` - Downloadable applications (simulators, tools)
  - `zip/modules/` - Module-specific downloads organized by module code (lnk, mlt, pab, etc.)
  - `img/`, `font/`, `mp3/` - Media assets
- `/src/` - React components and custom pages

### Sidebar Configuration

**Key file**: [sidebars.ts](sidebars.ts) defines 4 auto-generated sidebars:
- `guidesSidebar`, `instrumentsSidebar`, `modulesSidebar`, `caseAndPowerSidebar`
- All use `type: 'autogenerated'` - structure follows directory hierarchy
- No manual sidebar configuration needed - just organize files in folders

### Authors & Metadata

- Blog posts use author metadata from [blog/authors.yml](blog/authors.yml) (currently only `lars`)
- Module docs include rich frontmatter: `draft`, `title`, `sidebar_position`

## Development Workflows

### Local Development

```powershell
npm start          # Start dev server (NOT yarn)
npm run build      # Production build
npm run serve      # Preview production build locally
npm run typecheck  # TypeScript validation
```

**Important**: This project uses `npm`, not `yarn` (despite README mentioning yarn).

### Deployment

**Use**: [deploy.ps1](deploy.ps1) - PowerShell script that sets `GIT_USER=creatorlars` and runs `npm run deploy`

```powershell
.\deploy.ps1  # Deploy to GitHub Pages
```

Deploys to `lzxindustries.github.io` main branch via Docusaurus deploy command. No CI/CD automation exists yet.

## Content Conventions

### Draft Status Guidelines

Documents marked `draft: true` are work-in-progress and should remain in draft state until documentation is complete. Complete documentation includes:

**For modules** (study [stairs.md](docs/modules/stairs.md), [smx3.md](docs/modules/smx3.md), [esg3.md](docs/modules/esg3.md) as examples):
- Frontmatter with `title: "CODE: Full Name"` and `draft: false`
- Custom `ResponsiveYouTube` component at top (if video available)
- Image imports from `/img/modules/{module-code}/` directory
- Module header with subtitle: `# CODE` followed by `<span class="head2_nolink">Full Name</span>`
- Front panel image
- **## Overview** - Description, functionality, legacy comparison
- **## Key Specifications** table - Width, Power, Connectors, Included items, Video Sync
- **## System Integration Advice** - How module fits into larger systems, pairing suggestions
- **## Controls & Connectors** (or **Controls, Connectors & Indicators**) - Detailed description of all front panel elements
- **## Operation** - How to use the module, subsections for different modes/features
- **## Video Tutorial** (optional) - Embedded YouTube using ResponsiveYouTube component
- **## Example Patches** (optional) - Illustrated patch examples
- **## Installation** - Requirements and step-by-step procedure
- **## Full Specifications** - Comprehensive table with line art diagram showing labeled jacks/pots
- **## Maintenance** (optional) - Cleaning and care instructions
- **## Hardware Revisions** (optional) - Version tracking notes

**For P-Series modules** (simpler, study [lnk.md](docs/modules/lnk.md), [pgo.md](docs/modules/pgo.md)):
- Same frontmatter structure
- Simplified sections: Overview (optional), Key Specs, Connectors, Operation, Example Patches, Installation, Full Specs
- Emphasis on practical patch examples showing different uses

**For instruments** (only [videomancer.md](docs/instruments/videomancer.md) is `draft: false`):
- Similar structure to modules but instrument-scale complexity
- Many instrument docs remain in draft (Chromagnon, Vidiot) - incomplete

### Module Documentation Structure

Module docs (e.g., [docs/modules/dsg3.md](docs/modules/dsg3.md)) follow this pattern:
1. **Custom React component** at top for responsive YouTube embeds:
```jsx
export function ResponsiveYouTube({ videoId }) { /* ... */ }
```
2. **Image imports** using absolute paths from `/img/modules/{module-code}/`:
```jsx
import module_frontpanel from '/img/modules/{code}/{code}-diagrams/{code}_frontpanel.png';
```
3. **Module title pattern**: 
```markdown
# CODE
<span class="head2_nolink">Full Name</span>
```
4. **Math equations** using KaTeX: Wrap inline in `$`, blocks in `$$`
5. **Warnings/notes** using Docusaurus admonitions: `:::note`, `:::warning`, `:::tip`

### Image Organization Standards

**Module images**: `/static/img/modules/{module-code}/{module-code}-diagrams/`
- Pattern: `{module-code}_description.png` (underscores, lowercase)
- Examples: `dsg3_frontpanel.png`, `smx3_line_art_labeled_496x1024.png`
- Animated GIFs: `{module-code}_feature.gif` (e.g., `dsg3_fold.gif`)
- Shared assets: `/static/img/modules/_shared_assets/`

**Firmware**: `/static/firmware/{module}_{version}/`
- Pattern: `{module}_{version}/{module}_{version}.bin`
- Examples: `dsg3_1.0.0/dsg3_1.0.0.bin`, `esg3_1.1.0/esg3_1.1.0.bin`

**PDF documentation**: `/static/pdf/{product-or-module}/`
- Examples: `vidiot/`, `cadet-i-sync-generator/`, `memory-palace/`

**Downloadable apps**: `/static/zip/apps/`
- Pattern: `{app-name}-{platform}-portable.zip`
- Example: `chromagnon-simulator-windows-portable.zip`

**Module downloads**: `/static/zip/modules/{module-code}/`
- Organized by module code subdirectories

### Blog Post Pattern

- **Folder structure**: `blog/YYYY-MM-DD-slug/index.md`
- **Frontmatter**: `slug`, `title`, `authors: [lars]`, `tags`
- **Excerpt marker**: `<!--truncate-->` placed after intro paragraph
- **Static files**: Can live alongside `index.md` or reference `/static/` paths
- **Reference format**: Use absolute paths like `/zip/apps/filename.zip`

### Module Spec Table

[docs/modules/module-list.md](docs/modules/module-list.md) is the **master source of truth** for all LZX modules:
- Brand, Name, Status (Active/Legacy), Series, Width (HP), Depth, Power (+12V/-12V), Power type, Video sync
- **Must be updated** when adding new module documentation
- Power type standards: "Barrel or 16-pin" (Gen3), "Barrel or 10-pin" (P-Series), "Euro 16-pin" (Legacy)

## Key Technologies & Plugins

- **Mermaid diagrams**: Enabled via `@docusaurus/theme-mermaid`
- **Math equations**: KaTeX support via `remark-math` and `rehype-katex`, loaded from CDN
- **Image zoom**: `docusaurus-plugin-image-zoom` on `.markdown > img`
- **Redirects**: `@docusaurus/plugin-client-redirects` for URL migrations
- **Draw.io**: `docusaurus-plugin-drawio` for diagram editing

## Style & Theming

- **Default mode**: Dark theme (`defaultMode: 'dark'`) with light mode option
- **Custom CSS**: [src/css/custom.css](src/css/custom.css)
- **Custom fonts**: Relief Single Line Outline font preloaded in head tags
- **Logo**: Separate light/dark SVG logos in navbar (`logo.svg`, `logo-dark.svg`)
- **Module subtitle styling**: Use `<span class="head2_nolink">` for module full names

## Important Constraints & Known Issues

1. **Draft status**: Many docs have `draft: true` - these are incomplete and should not be published
2. **Power standards**: Gen3 uses "Barrel or 16-pin", P-Series uses "Barrel or 10-pin", Legacy uses "Euro 16-pin"
3. **Module naming**: Title format is "CODE: Full Name" (e.g., "DSG3: Dual Shape Generator")
4. **Broken links**: Config has `onBrokenLinks: 'throw'` but `onBrokenMarkdownLinks: 'warn'`
5. **Blog feed**: RSS feed limited to 10 most recent posts in config
6. **No CI/CD**: Deployment is manual via PowerShell script only
7. **README outdated**: References `yarn` but project uses `npm`

## Common Tasks

### Add a new module doc
1. Create `docs/modules/{module-code}.md` with proper frontmatter (`draft: true` initially)
2. Create image directory `/static/img/modules/{module-code}/{module-code}-diagrams/`
3. Add images following naming convention: `{module-code}_description.png`
4. Follow complete documentation structure (see Draft Status Guidelines)
5. Update [docs/modules/module-list.md](docs/modules/module-list.md) spec table
6. Set `draft: false` only when all sections are complete
7. Module automatically appears in sidebar (autogenerated from filesystem)

### Add a blog post
1. Create `blog/YYYY-MM-DD-slug-name/index.md`
2. Set frontmatter: `slug`, `title`, `authors: [lars]`, `tags: [tag1, tag2]`
3. Add `<!--truncate-->` after intro paragraph for excerpt
4. Place images in same folder or reference `/static/` paths with absolute paths
5. Use date format YYYY-MM-DD in folder name

### Add firmware release
1. Create folder `/static/firmware/{module}_{version}/`
2. Place binary as `{module}_{version}.bin` inside folder
3. Reference in docs with path `/firmware/{module}_{version}/{module}_{version}.bin`

### Add static downloads
1. Apps: `/static/zip/apps/{app-name}-{platform}-portable.zip`
2. Module files: `/static/zip/modules/{module-code}/`
3. PDFs: `/static/pdf/{product-or-module}/`
4. Reference with absolute paths: `/zip/apps/file.zip`
5. CNAME file in `/static/` preserves custom domain on deploy

## Video Synthesis Domain Knowledge

- **HP (Horizontal Pitch)**: EuroRack width measurement (1HP ≈ 5.08mm)
- **Video sync**: Analog video timing signals (composite, sync on green, genlock)
- **Raster generation**: Creating scan patterns for displays/lasers
- **Chroma keying**: Color-based compositing techniques
- **Cartesian processing**: XY-based video manipulation
- **ILDA**: International Laser Display Association standard for laser control
- **Component video**: YPbPr (luma + color difference) vs RGB vs RGsB (sync on green)
- **Video standards**: NTSC (486i59), PAL (576i50), HD formats (720p, 1080i/p at various frame rates)
- **Luminance formula**: `Y = 0.299R + 0.587G + 0.114B` (used in video signal processing)
